commerce_entitlements_exactly_one_source.name: commerce_entitlements_exactly_one_source
commerce_entitlements_exactly_one_source.value: (("commerce_entitlements"."source_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commerce_entitlements"."source_subscription_id" IS NULL) OR ("commerce_entitlements"."source_order_id" IS NULL AND "commerce_entitlements"."source_subscription_id" IS NOT NULL))

commerce_orders_financial_evidence.name: commerce_orders_financial_evidence
commerce_orders_financial_evidence.value: ("commerce_orders"."price_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commerce_orders"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "commerce_orders"."amount_total" IS NOT NULL) OR ("commerce_orders"."provider" IN ('apple_sandbox', 'google_test') AND "commerce_orders"."price_id" IS NULL AND "commerce_orders"."currency" IS NULL AND "commerce_orders"."amount_total" IS NULL)

marketing_jobs_request_check.name: marketing_jobs_request_check
marketing_jobs_request_check.value: cardinality("marketing_generation_jobs"."requested_outputs") BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND array_position("marketing_generation_jobs"."requested_outputs", NULL) IS NULL

marketing_jobs_lease_check.name: marketing_jobs_lease_check
marketing_jobs_lease_check.value: ("marketing_generation_jobs"."status" IN ('claimed', 'processing') AND "marketing_generation_jobs"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("marketing_generation_jobs"."worker_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "marketing_generation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "marketing_generation_jobs"."attempts" > 0) OR ("marketing_generation_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('claimed', 'processing') AND "marketing_generation_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

marketing_outputs_payload_check.name: marketing_outputs_payload_check
marketing_outputs_payload_check.value: ("marketing_generation_outputs"."text_content" IS NOT NULL OR "marketing_generation_outputs"."structured_content_json" IS NOT NULL OR "marketing_generation_outputs"."media_asset_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("marketing_generation_outputs"."text_content" IS NULL OR octet_length("marketing_generation_outputs"."text_content") <= 262144) AND ("marketing_generation_outputs"."structured_content_json" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("marketing_generation_outputs"."structured_content_json") = 'object' AND octet_length("marketing_generation_outputs"."structured_content_json"::text) <= 524288))

marketing_snapshots_bounds_check.name: marketing_snapshots_bounds_check
marketing_snapshots_bounds_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("marketing_source_snapshots"."facts_json") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."facts_json") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND jsonb_typeof("marketing_source_snapshots"."places_json") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."places_json") BETWEEN 1 AND 50
    AND jsonb_typeof("marketing_source_snapshots"."references_json") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."references_json") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND jsonb_typeof("marketing_source_snapshots"."media_json") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."media_json") <= 50
    AND jsonb_typeof("marketing_source_snapshots"."brand_rules_json") = 'object'
    AND octet_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."facts_json"::text) <= 262144
    AND octet_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."places_json"::text) <= 4096
    AND octet_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."references_json"::text) <= 131072
    AND octet_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."media_json"::text) <= 16384
    AND octet_length("marketing_source_snapshots"."brand_rules_json"::text) <= 16384

brand_revision_shape.name: brand_revision_shape
brand_revision_shape.value: "brand_context_revisions"."revision" > 0 AND "brand_context_revisions"."schema_version" = 1 AND jsonb_typeof("brand_context_revisions"."context_json") = 'object' AND octet_length("brand_context_revisions"."context_json"::text) <= 1048576 AND "brand_context_revisions"."context_json"->>'contextId' = "brand_context_revisions"."context_id"::text AND "brand_context_revisions"."context_json"->>'projectId' = "brand_context_revisions"."project_id"::text AND "brand_context_revisions"."context_json"->>'revision' = "brand_context_revisions"."revision"::text AND "brand_context_revisions"."context_json"->>'schemaVersion' = '1' AND "brand_context_revisions"."context_json" ?& ARRAY['contextId','projectId','revision','schemaVersion'] AND "brand_context_revisions"."digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
